questions.q: What does a foreign key enforce?
options: Every value in the column must already exist as a primary key value in another table
The column must always contain unique values within its own table
The table must have at least one index
The column can never be updated once set
questions.explain: This is referential integrity — a foreign key prevents rows from pointing to something that doesn't exist.

questions.q: What happens if you try to insert a row whose foreign key value doesn't exist in the referenced table?
options: The statement fails with Error 547
SQL Server automatically creates the missing referenced row
The value is silently set to NULL
The insert succeeds but a warning is logged
questions.explain: Error 547 is the standard constraint violation error raised when an operation would break referential integrity.

questions.q: What is the default behavior when you try to delete a row that other rows still reference via a foreign key?
options: The delete fails — SQL Server refuses to create an orphaned row
The referencing rows are automatically deleted
The referencing rows' foreign key values are set to NULL
The delete succeeds silently with no consequence
questions.explain: Without ON DELETE CASCADE, SQL Server blocks deletes that would orphan dependent rows.

questions.q: What does ON DELETE CASCADE do?
options: Automatically deletes dependent rows when the referenced row is deleted
Prevents any row from ever being deleted
Automatically creates a backup before every delete
Converts the foreign key into a primary key
questions.explain: It changes the default block-on-delete behavior into an automatic cascading delete of dependent rows.

questions.q: In AdventureWorks2012, what does Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID being a foreign key guarantee?
options: Every product's subcategory ID must correspond to a real row in Production.ProductSubcategory
Every product must belong to exactly one category, not a subcategory
The subcategory table cannot have more than 255 rows
Products can only be inserted through a stored procedure
questions.explain: The foreign key ties Product to a real, existing ProductSubcategory row — no product can reference a subcategory that doesn't exist.
